faq.question: Is hammer allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Hammer is not allowed in carry-on luggage. Hammers, along with other heavy tools like crowbars and drills, can be used as bludgeoning weapons and are strictly prohibited in the cabin.

faq.question: Can you pack hammer in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Hammer is allowed in checked bags.
